question: As of July 2023, who has become the second longest serving Chief Minister of an Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naveen Patnaik.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Naveen Patnaik, the **Chief Minister of Odisha**, became the **second-longest serving Chief Minister** of an Indian state as of July 2023.
 
• He has been serving as the Chief Minister **since March 2000**, consistently winning elections and leading the Biju Janata Dal (BJD).
 
• Patnaik is known for his focus on** social welfare schemes and disaster management**, which have garnered him widespread popularity.
 
• His tenure has seen significant development in infrastructure, education, and healthcare in Odisha.
 
• He is also recognized for maintaining a clean and corruption-free image throughout his political career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1812ea40d45ce5e492dbd1c0879d1061a79cac2fc10623e5486043fbf578bf88.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shivraj Singh Chauhan:**

 
 
• Shivraj Singh Chauhan is the **Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• He has served multiple terms as CM, with his first term starting in 2005, but his total tenure is not as long as Naveen Patnaik’s.
 
• He is known for implementing various **agriculture and rural development programs.**
 
 
 
• **Yogi Adityanath:**
 
 
• Yogi Adityanath is the** Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh since 2017.**
 
• He is notable for his strong stance on law and order and promoting development projects in the state.
 
• His tenure is far shorter compared to Naveen Patnaik's.
 
 
 
• **Pawan Kumar Chamling:**
 
 
• Pawan Kumar Chamling was the** longest-serving Chief Minister of Sikkim,** having served from 1994 to 2019.
 
• He held the record as the longest-serving CM before Naveen Patnaik moved up to second place in terms of service length.
 
• Chamling is known for his work in** environmental preservation and social welfare** in Sikkim.
